liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Birdsong** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer singles out the song as a jamming highlight; Bob played acoustic guitar and switched to electric halfway through this song [3][13]
- **Truckin** (1 review): Bobby flubbed the lyrics during this song [12]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Bobby fumbled the first verse; the segue into Fire saw John Mayer take the jam somewhere new [12]
- **Big Railroad Blues** (1 review): Reviewer says it was a really jamming version [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Big Railroad**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Milestones**: back after 84 archived shows (722 days); rare: 14 archived performances [14]

## The recordings

- **deadco2019-11-09.DeadCo2019-11-09Hampton** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 175 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **deadco2019-11-09**: source not stated; 20 songs; 172 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **DeadCo2019-11-09.travitz.schoepsMK4v.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 176 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer found the recording deeply satisfying on vintage planar-magnetic headphones [10]
- **deadandcompany2019-11-09.neumann_skm150.sunboy.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording excellent [11]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes a setlist full of old favorites and a Ripple encore, imperfect but joyful [12]
- Second of two Hampton Coliseum shows, nicknamed the Mothership, and last show of the fall run [2]
- Lineup: Mickey Hart, Bill Kreutzmann, Bob Weir, Oteil Burbridge, Jeff Chimenti and John Mayer [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2019-11-09.DeadCo2019-11-09Hampton**: taped by JT/NY; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > Nakamichi CM300's w CP4's > GAKable's > Sound Devices 722 @ 24/96 [1]. Also: Audience source: Nakamichi CM300 mics with CP4 capsules, GAK cables, Sound Devices 722 at 24/96, edited in Sound Forge Pro 12, FLAC via Traders Little Helper [1]
- **deadco2019-11-09**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: Microtech Gefell M21 > nBob actives > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (24/48) [2]
- **DeadCo2019-11-09.travitz.schoepsMK4v.flac16**: taped by Jeff Travitz; transferred by Keith Litznberger; source: Schoeps CMC64v's>Grace Design Lunatec V3>Sound Devices 744t [3]. Also: Schoeps CMC64v mics into Grace Design Lunatec V3 and Sound Devices 744t at 16-bit/44.1kHz, finished with Sound Forge Pro 13 and Foobar2000 [3]
- **deadandcompany2019-11-09.neumann_skm150.sunboy.flac16**: taped by Steven Weld; transferred by Steven Weld; source: Neumann SKM150(AK50's/LC3's/KM100's)>GAKables xlr>Lunatec V2>GAKables xlr>Apogee Mini-Me@24/96>AES/EBU>Sound Devices 722 @24bit/96kHz [4]. Also: Taped on the GA floor just in front of the mixer, a few feet right of center, with Neumann SKM150 mics into a Sound Devices 722 at 24/96 [4]
